raw_text:
This file guides Claude Code (claude.ai/code) for this Rust Titan Exchange WebSocket client/CLI.

Commands:
```sh
cargo build --release
cargo run --features cli --bin titan-cli -- --help
cargo run --features cli --bin titan-cli -- info
cargo run --features cli --bin titan-cli -- price SOL USDC 1000000000
cargo run --features cli --bin titan-cli -- stream SOL USDC 1000000000
cargo run --features cli --bin titan-cli -- swap --keypair ~/.config/solana/id.json SOL USDC 100000000
cargo run --features cli --bin titan-cli -- watch
cargo test --test [name]
cargo clippy --all-targets
```

`TitanClient` is thread-safe (`Arc` internally), owns config/WebSocket/streams. Tokio dispatches messages and exponentially reconnects. `StreamManager` queues at `concurrentStreams`; shared `Arc<AtomicBool>` ensures exactly one slot decrement via `stop()`/`Drop`, `StreamEnd`, or reconnect failure. `ResumableStream.on_end` bridges endings; reconnection updates `effective_stream_id: Arc<AtomicU32>`.

Files: `src/lib.rs`, `client.rs`, `config.rs`, `connection.rs`, `error.rs`, `state.rs`, `stream.rs`, `queue.rs`, `instructions.rs`, `tls.rs`, `bin/titan_cli.rs`.

Environment: `TITAN_URL`, `TITAN_TOKEN` (required), `SOLANA_RPC_URL`, `TITAN_DANGER_ACCEPT_INVALID_CERTS` (dev only). Defaults: token required; max reconnect delay 30,000 ms; reconnect attempts infinite; `auto_wrap_sol=false`; invalid certs false; `one_shot_timeout_ms=10,000`; ping/pong connection defaults. URLs: `wss://us1.api.demo.titan.exchange/api/v1/ws` / `wss://api.titan.ag/api/v1/ws`.

Streaming may send initial empty `SwapQuotes`; tests should not assert `!quotes.quotes.is_empty()` unless using a real wallet address.

**Maximum file size: ~200 lines** - Split larger files  
**mod.rs files should be empty** - Only contain mod declarations, move content to meaningful file names  
Use helper structs with static methods for clear separation (e.g., `TitanHelper::method()`)  
Single error enum for the crate (`TitanClientError`)  
All fallible operations must return `Result`.
